m03_80.say: Welcome to this afternoon's corporate export compliance workshop. Today we're clarifying 2020 Shipping Terms rules, because choosing the wrong three-letter code can expose our company to unexpected liabilities. Looking at the summary table on your screen, notice the critical difference between FOB and CIF. Many of our sales reps mistakenly believe that under CIF—Cost, Insurance, and Freight—the seller bears the transit risk all the way until the ship reaches the buyer's destination port. In reality, under both FOB and CIF, risk transfers to the buyer the moment the goods are loaded on board the vessel at the origin port! The only difference is who pays for main ocean freight and minimum insurance. By contrast, for our upcoming European contract, the buyer insists that our company handle everything door-to-door—meaning we take care of both main ocean carriage and import customs clearance in their country, while risk stays with us until arrival at their named destination.

Welcome back to Global Trade Insights. Today we're joined by trade finance specialist Nadia Kapoor to discuss Letters of Credit—still the backbone of secure international trade. Nadia, what is the biggest mistake exporters make when shipping under an LC?
Well, David, exporters often focus solely on getting the goods onto the ship and treat the paperwork as an afterthought. Under international banking rules, issuing banks examine documents strictly on their face. Even a single misspelled street name can freeze half a million dollars! If the shipping document, packing list, and certificate of origin don't match the Letter of Credit word for word, the bank has the legal right to reject the documents and withhold payment until the buyer waives the discrepancy.

m03_157.text:
Global Supply Chains Pivot Toward "China Plus One" Resilience
Over the past three years, multinational manufacturers have accelerated investments in Vietnam, India, and Mexico to reduce overdependence on single-country sourcing. According to a recent survey by the Global Logistics Council, 68 percent of surveyed electronics and apparel firms now source critical subassemblies from at least three countries, up from 39 percent in 2021.

However, shifting production is rarely instantaneous. Emerging manufacturing hubs often face infrastructure bottlenecks, including shallower port drafts that prevent mega-vessels from docking directly, forcing reliance on feeder ships through transshipment hubs like Singapore or Busan. Furthermore, complex Rules of Origin under regional trade pacts mean that merely assembling imported components in a second country may not qualify finished goods for preferential tariff rates. Supply chain architects warn that true resilience requires mapping not only Tier-1 suppliers, but also Tier-2 and Tier-3 raw material vendors.

ASEAN–JAPAN COMPREHENSIVE ECONOMIC PARTNERSHIP (AJCEP) — ORIGIN GUIDELINES
To qualify for preferential 0% import duty on Industrial Electric Motors (HS 8501.52) imported into Japan from an ASEAN member state (such as Thailand or Malaysia), exporters must satisfy the Product Specific Rule (PSR):
- Regional Value Content (RVC) of at least 40%, OR
- Change in Tariff Heading (CTH) (all non-originating materials used in production must be classified in a 4-digit HS heading other than 8501).

Our latest shipment of 200 AC induction motors from Siam ElectroDrive cleared Osaka Customs yesterday duty-free under AJCEP Form AJ #TH-2026-08812, saving us ¥1.35 million in standard MFN tariffs (5%).

However, during our routine supplier cost-breakdown audit this morning, we discovered a potential compliance risk. • 解析：報導主軸為 severe seasonal drought continues to restrict water levels in the Panama Canal，同義改寫為 (D)「限制海上航道的環境條件」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 引用 rail、isthmus、marine fuel、36 捏造新聞重點。

questions.q: How are shipping lines responding to the situation?
options: By waiting fourteen days at the canal entrance
By paying extra fees to exceed the 24-ship daily cap
By lightening ship weight or taking longer alternate paths
By suspending all Asia-to-U.S. East Coast sailings

explain.text:

• 解析：船公司透過鐵路轉運減輕吃水深度或繞道非洲南端，同義改寫為 (C)「減輕船隻載重或改走較長的替代航線」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(A) 引用 Asia-to-U.S. East Coast、24、fourteen days 誇大或扭曲應對方式。

questions.q: What impact is predicted for global retailers?
options: Extended restocking cycles and increased holding expenses
A permanent switch to African rail transport
Immediate fuel rebates from shipping lines
Lower demand during the peak shopping season

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：零售商將面臨 longer inventory lead times and higher carrying costs，同義改寫為 (A)「補貨週期拉長且持有成本增加」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 引用 peak shopping season、fuel、Africa、rail 捏造影響。
• 單字補充：maritime passage 海上通道；restocking cycle 補貨週期。

questions.q: What kind of business is the caller contacting?

questions.q: Which option should a caller press to check on a detained package?

• 解析：If your shipment has been detained by customs... press 3 對應 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 預約取件/報價；(B) 更新地址；(D) 帳務查詢。

questions.q: What information should callers have ready before speaking with a representative?
options: A copy of the commercial invoice

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：10-digit air waybill or tracking number 同義改寫為 (A)「十位數貨件追蹤代碼」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(C) 引用 commercial invoice、delivery address、freight quote 等其他按鍵提到的名詞。
• 單字補充：expedited 加急的；detained 被扣留的。

Q89–Q91（自動化發貨中心開幕致詞）

questions.q: Why is the speaker giving this speech?
options: To introduce new safety rules for port terminals
To mark the launch of a mechanized distribution site
To announce a $120 million retail expansion
To honor engineers retiring from the Savannah plant

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：grand opening of our new 400,000-square-foot automated fulfillment center 同義改寫為 (B)「慶祝機械化配送據點啟用」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(D) 引用 $120 million、retail、safety、engineers、Savannah 捏造致詞目的。

questions.q: What feature of the new facility does the speaker emphasize?
options: Custom safety vests designed by floor engineers
A direct rail link to the Savannah port terminal

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：robotic sorting and retrieval system capable of processing 80,000... parcels per hour 同義改寫為 (D)「高速自動化物件處理技術」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 引用 Savannah、port terminal、400,000-square-foot、safety vest 設陷阱。

questions.q: What are attendees invited to do after the speech?
options: Inspect 80,000 export parcels at the gate
Watch a presentation in the Savannah port lounge
Walk through the operations area with technical staff

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：join our floor engineers for a guided tour of the packing floor 同義改寫為 (D)「在技術人員陪同下參觀作業區」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 引用 Savannah、Southeast、retail clients、80,000 捏造會後活動。

Q92–Q94（Podcast 訪談：信用狀單據審核）

questions.q: What is the guest's area of expertise?

explain.text:
正解：(C)
• 解析：受訪者為 trade finance specialist 並專精 Letters of Credit，同義歸納為 (C)「國際支付工具」。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(D) 引用 ship、certificate of origin、buyer 設陷阱。

questions.q: Why does the guest warn exporters against discrepancies in documents?
options: Financial institutions may decline to release funds.
Customs officials will seize the certificate of origin.
Buyers must pay double for a new packing list.
Shipping lines will unload the goods from the ship.

explain.text:

• 解析：the bank has the legal right to reject the documents and withhold payment 同義改寫為 (A)「金融機構可能拒絕撥款」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 引用 goods、ship、buyer、packing list、certificate of origin 誇大後果。

questions.q: What does the guest imply when she says, "Even a single misspelled street name can freeze half a million dollars"?
options: Buyers frequently waive minor spelling mistakes.
Shipping documents are rarely checked before sailing.
Exporters often lose half a million dollars on street deliveries.
Lenders require exact accuracy across all submitted paperwork.

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：Even a single misspelled street name can freeze half a million dollars 強調銀行嚴格審查單據字面一致性，同義改寫為 (D)「放款機構要求所有提交文件必須完全精確」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(B) 引用 half a million dollars、street、waives、shipping document 曲解原意。
• 單字補充：payment instrument 支付工具；decline to release funds 拒絕撥款。

Q95–Q97（圖表題：港口泊位簡報）

questions.q: Who is the speaker most likely addressing?
options: Harbor pilots waiting for the 14:00 shift

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：說話者對團隊下達 lead supervisor 任務並討論各泊位作業，同義歸納為 (A)「港口營運主管」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 引用 harbor pilot、14:00、Gothenburg、Gantry Crane 設陷阱。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which berth requires immediate attention due to an equipment issue?

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：【圖表交叉比對】圖表中有兩艘船顯示 Delayed（B-14 與 B-11），獨白指出「前往 Felixstowe 的船因 7 號橋式起重機液壓問題而需立即維修」，對照圖表 Felixstowe 對應泊位 B-14。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(D) 皆為圖表中的其他泊位，其中 (D) B-11 同樣顯示 Delayed 但原因為等待領港員（awaiting a harbor pilot）。

questions.q: What does the speaker instruct the team to do regarding MV Atlantic Wave?
options: Wait for a harbor pilot from Hamburg
Complete loading records and cast off

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：請 B-12 主管 finalize the stowage plan and release mooring lines，同義改寫為 (D)「完成裝載紀錄並解纜啟航」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 引用 Gantry Crane 7、14:00、harbor pilot、Hamburg、16:30 混搭其他船隻資訊。
• 單字補充：stowage plan 積載圖；cast off 解纜啟航。

Q98–Q100（自由貿易協定原產地規則簡報）

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the talk?
options: To review procurement cost breakdowns from last quarter
To clarify revised trade-pact qualification standards
To introduce new industrial machinery from overseas vendors
To announce a 45 percent increase in MFN tariffs

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：主題為 updated Rules of Origin under our regional Free Trade Agreement，同義改寫為 (B)「說明修訂後的貿易協定資格標準」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(A) 引用 45 percent、MFN tariffs、industrial machinery、procurement、quarter 設陷阱。

questions.q: What happens if a product fails to meet the Regional Value Content threshold?
options: It loses eligibility for zero-tariff entry.
It is rejected by procurement teams next quarter.
The vendor must pay a 45 percent import penalty.
It is automatically classified as industrial machinery.

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：若未達門檻則 cannot qualify for preferential duty-free treatment，同義改寫為 (A)「喪失零關稅入境資格」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 引用 procurement teams、45 percent、industrial machinery 捏造罰則或後果。

questions.q: What resource will the speaker distribute at the end of the session?
options: A copy of the regional Free Trade Agreement
A list of MFN tariff rates for next quarter
A verification form for vendor cost data

explain.text:
正解：(C)
• 解析：會後將發放 standardized supplier declaration checklist，同義改寫為 (C)「供應商成本資料查核表」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 引用 MFN tariff、Free Trade Agreement、40 percent 設陷阱。
• 單字補充：eligibility 資格；verification form 查核表單。

questions.q: All consignments containing lithium-ion batteries must be accompanied by a signed safety declaration ______ to vessel loading.

explain.text:
正解：(B) prior
• 考點：固定介系詞片語搭配（prior to）。
• 解析：空格後接 to vessel loading，需用 prior to（在…之前）。
• 誘答分析：(D) previous to 雖偶見於非正式語，多益正式用法必選 prior to；(C) former 不接 to；(A) ahead 需搭配 of。
• 單字補充：be accompanied by 隨附、safety declaration 安全聲明書。

questions.q: Should customs authorities ______ any discrepancy between the commercial invoice and the physical cargo, clearance will be suspended immediately.

explain.text:
正解：(C) detect
• 考點：假設語氣與條件句倒裝（省略 if）。
• 解析：句首 Should customs authorities ______ 為 If customs authorities should detect... 的倒裝，助動詞 Should 提前，後面動詞需用原形 detect。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(A)、(D) 均不符合助動詞後接原形動詞的結構。
• 單字補充：discrepancy 差異/不符、suspend 暫停。

questions.q: The logistics division implemented an automated route-optimization algorithm, ______ transit times across Southeast Asian corridors by nearly 18 percent.

explain.text:
正解：(C) reducing
• 考點：分詞構句表結果。
• 解析：逗號前為完整子句，逗號後無連接詞，須使用現在分詞 reducing 表主動伴隨結果（「進而縮短了…近 18% 的運輸時間」）。
• 誘答分析：(D)、(A) 為限定動詞，缺少連接詞不能接在逗號後；(B) 被動語態不合（後方有受詞 transit times）。
• 單字補充：route-optimization algorithm 路線最佳化演算法、corridor 運輸走廊。

questions.q: ______ the severe congestion at West Coast ports, Pacifica Electronics decided to divert half of its fourth-quarter inventory through Vancouver.

explain.text:
正解：(A) In light of
• 考點：介系詞片語與連接詞辨析。
• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 the severe congestion...，需填入介系詞片語 In light of（鑑於、考量到）。
• 誘答分析：(D) Because、(C) Even though、(B) Whereas 皆為從屬連接詞，後須接完整子句。
• 單字補充：congestion 壅塞、divert 轉移/改道。

questions.q: Under the revised shipping terms agreement, the exporter bears full financial responsibility for marine insurance ______ the goods reach the designated port of discharge.

explain.text:
正解：(A) until
• 考點：時間副詞子句連接詞辨析。
• 解析：語意為「出口商承擔海運保險的全部財務責任，直到貨物抵達指定卸貨港為止」，選 until。
• 誘答分析：(B) unless 除非；(D) while 當…時（持續動作，不配 reach 瞬間動詞）；(C) despite 為介系詞。
• 單字補充：port of discharge 卸貨港、bear responsibility 承擔責任。

questions.q: Freight forwarders are strongly advised to verify the ______ of every product classification code before submitting electronic manifests.

explain.text:
正解：(D) accuracy
• 考點：詞性辨析（名詞）。
• 解析：定冠詞 the 與介系詞 of 之間須填入不可數名詞 accuracy（準確性）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 形容詞；(C) 副詞；(B) 複數名詞，此處指抽象準確性，不用複數。
• 單字補充：product classification (HS) code 國際商品統一分類代碼、electronic manifest 電子艙單。

questions.q: Neither the regional distribution manager nor the warehouse supervisors ______ notified of the sudden change in the carrier's gate-in deadline.

explain.text:
正解：(A) were
• 考點：主詞與動詞一致性（Neither A nor B）。
• 解析：Neither A nor B 連接兩主詞時，動詞依就近原則配合 B（the warehouse supervisors 複數），故選複數過去式 were。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(D)、(C) 皆為單數動詞。
• 單字補充：gate-in deadline 進場截止期限。

questions.q: To prevent moisture damage during long-haul ocean voyages, moisture-absorbing desiccant packs are placed ______ each sealed container.

explain.text:
正解：(D) within
• 考點：介系詞語意辨析。
• 解析：吸濕乾燥劑包應放置於每個密封貨櫃「內部」，within（在…裡面）最精準。
• 誘答分析：(C) among 用於三者以上之間；(B) toward 朝向；(A) upon 在…之上。
• 單字補充：desiccant 乾燥劑、long-haul 長途的。

questions.q: The procurement committee sought a vendor capable of ______ fluctuating seasonal demand without compromising product quality.

explain.text:
正解：(A) accommodating
• 考點：capable of + V-ing 結構。
• 解析：capable of 為介系詞結尾，後接動名詞 accommodating（滿足/因應…需求），且後方有受詞 fluctuating seasonal demand。
• 誘答分析：(C) 名詞後面不能直接帶名詞受詞；(B)、(D) 詞性不符。
• 單字補充：fluctuating 波動的、compromise 妥協/損害。

questions.q: ______ had the container ship cleared the Panama Canal than a mechanical failure forced it to anchor for emergency repairs.

explain.text:
正解：(C) No sooner
• 考點：倒裝句型與固定搭配（No sooner ... than）。
• 解析：句中出現 than，且句首為過去完成式倒裝 had the container ship cleared...，固定搭配為 No sooner ... than（一…就…）。
• 誘答分析：(D) Scarcely 與 (A) Hardly 須搭配 when 或 before，不可配 than；(B) Not only 語意不合。
• 單字補充：anchor 下錨停泊、mechanical failure 機械故障。

questions.q: Import tariffs on precision optical components vary ______ depending on whether the country of origin holds a bilateral trade pact.

explain.text:
正解：(A) considerably
• 考點：詞性辨析（副詞修飾動詞）。
• 解析：空格修飾動詞 vary（變化），須用副詞 considerably（相當大地）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 動詞；(C) 形容詞；(D) 名詞。
• 單字補充：bilateral trade pact 雙邊貿易協定、optical component 光學元件。

questions.q: The new bonded warehouse features temperature-controlled bays specifically ______ to preserve perishable pharmaceutical shipments.

explain.text:
正解：(B) designed
• 考點：過去分詞片語作後位修飾。
• 解析：bays（貨位/艙間）是被「設計」來保存易腐藥品的，省去 which are，保留過去分詞 designed。
• 誘答分析：(D)、(A)、(C) 皆無法構成被動修飾。
• 單字補充：perishable 易腐敗的、pharmaceutical 醫藥的。

questions.q: Ms. Lin requested that the revised shipping document ______ to the recipient's bank via express courier by Friday afternoon.

explain.text:
正解：(C) be sent
• 考點：要求動詞後的假設語氣（request that S + (should) + V原形）。
• 解析：requested 表示要求，其 that 子句須用 (should) + 原形動詞，貨運單據是「被寄送」，故選 be sent。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(D)、(A) 皆誤用一般時態。
• 單字補充：express courier 國際快遞、recipient 收貨人。

questions.q: Delays in returning empty containers beyond the allotted free time will ______ substantial daily detention charges from the shipping line.

explain.text:
正解：(B) incur
• 考點：商務動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：逾期歸還空櫃將「招致/產生」高額延滯費，固定搭配為 incur charges/fees。
• 誘答分析：(D) recur 再次發生（不及物）；(A) occur 發生（不及物）；(C) concur 同意。
• 單字補充：allotted free time 核定的免費使用期、detention charge 延滯費。

questions.q: ______ its modest fleet size, Meridian Air Cargo has earned a reputation for unmatched reliability in time-critical electronics deliveries.

explain.text:
正解：(C) Notwithstanding
• 考點：讓步介系詞辨析。
• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 its modest fleet size，語意表「儘管機隊規模不大，該公司仍贏得高可靠度聲譽」，選介系詞 Notwithstanding（儘管）。
• 誘答分析：(D) Although、(B) Provided that 為連接詞；(A) As opposed 須搭配 to。
• 單字補充：modest 規模適中的、unmatched 無可匹敵的。

questions.q: Once the port authority ______ the berth allocation schedule, dispatchers will assign local trucking trucks to retrieve the incoming containers.

explain.text:
正解：(B) finalizes
• 考點：時間副詞子句以現在簡單式代替未來式。
• 解析：Once 引導時間副詞子句，主要子句為未來式 will assign，故時間子句須用現在簡單式 finalizes（主詞 authority 為單數）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 不可在時間子句用 will；(C)、(A) 過去時態不合。
• 單字補充：berth allocation schedule 泊位分配表、local trucking truck 港口短程拖車。

questions.q: The compliance officer conducted a thorough audit of the export logs to ensure strict ______ with international sanctions regulations.

explain.text:
正解：(B) adherence
• 考點：詞性辨析與固定搭配（adherence to）。
• 解析：形容詞 strict 後須接名詞 adherence（遵守），與後方 to 構成 adherence to regulations。
• 誘答分析：(C) 動詞；(A) 名詞「擁護者/信徒」；(D) 動名詞一般不接在純形容詞 strict 後。
• 單字補充：sanctions 貿易制裁、compliance officer 法規遵循專員。

questions.q: Every pallet entering the automated sorting facility must display a scannable barcode label ______ the shipment's destination hub and weight.

explain.text:
正解：(D) indicating
• 考點：現在分詞作後位修飾。
• 解析：條碼標籤主動「顯示」目的地與重量，省去 which indicates，保留現在分詞 indicating。
• 誘答分析：(A) 缺關代不可用限定動詞；(C) 被動不合；(B) 名詞無連接功能。
• 單字補充：scannable 可掃描的、sorting facility 分揀中心。

questions.q: By the time the relief vessel arrives at Rotterdam next Thursday, the stranded cargo ______ at the terminal for nearly three weeks.

explain.text:
正解：(D) will have been sitting
• 考點：未來完成進行式（By the time + 現在式, S + will have been V-ing）。
• 解析：By the time the relief vessel arrives next Thursday 表示到未來某時間點為止已持續進行三週，須用未來完成進行式 will have been sitting。
• 誘答分析：(B) 單純未來式無法表現「已持續三週」；(C)、(A) 非未來時態。
• 單字補充：relief vessel 救援/替補船隻、stranded 滯留的。

questions.q: Importers who fail to settle assessed duties within the statutory grace period risk having their merchandise ______ at public auction.

explain.text:
正解：(C) liquidated
• 考點：使役/遭遇結構（have + 受詞 + Vpp）。
• 解析：語意為「進口商恐面臨商品被公開拍賣變現的風險」，商品 their merchandise 與 liquidate（拍賣變現/清償）為被動關係，故選過去分詞 liquidated。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(A)、(D) 無法表達受詞被動遭遇。
• 單字補充：statutory grace period 法定寬限期、public auction 公開拍賣。

questions.q: The trade ministry's latest directive aims to ______ cross-border customs procedures by digitizing agricultural inspection certificates.

explain.text:
正解：(A) streamline
• 考點：商務動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：透過數位化農業檢疫證書來「簡化/使流暢」跨境海關程序，選 streamline。
• 誘答分析：(B) sideline 邊緣化；(D) underline 強調；(C) outshine 勝過。
• 單字補充：directive 指令、agricultural inspection certificate 農業檢疫證明書。

questions.q: ______ the supplier can guarantee a minimum monthly output of 50,000 units, we cannot commit to an exclusive two-year contract.

explain.text:
正解：(B) Unless
• 考點：條件連接詞語意辨析。
• 解析：後半句為否定「我們無法承諾兩年獨家合約」，前半句條件為「除非（Unless）供應商能保證每月至少五萬件產量」。
• 誘答分析：(C) Provided（只要）、(D) In case（萬一）、(A) Supposing（假設）皆使前後邏輯矛盾。
• 單字補充：exclusive contract 獨家合約、minimum monthly output 每月最低產量。

questions.q: High-value machinery exported under temporary admission rules is ______ from import duties, provided it is re-exported within twelve months.

explain.text:
正解：(B) exempt
• 考點：固定形容詞搭配（be exempt from）。
• 解析：暫准進口的高價值機械只要在 12 個月內復運出口，即可「免除」進口關稅，固定搭配 exempt from。
• 誘答分析：(D) absent 缺席的；(C) vacant 空缺的；(A) devoid 缺乏的（接 of）。
• 單字補充：temporary admission 暫准通關、re-export 復運出口。

questions.q: The operations director emphasized that ______ clear communication between brokers and carriers, bottlenecks at border checkpoints are inevitable.

explain.text:
正解：(B) without
• 考點：介系詞語意與文法辨析。
• 解析：語意為「若沒有報關行與承運人之間清楚的溝通，邊境瓶頸勢必難免」，選介系詞 without。
• 誘答分析：(D) beside 在旁邊；(C) except 除了；(A) lacking 若作介系詞不加 of。
• 單字補充：inevitable 不可避免的、checkpoint 檢查站。

questions.q: ______ of the three proposed rail routes through Central Asia offered both winter reliability and competitive per-ton freight rates.

explain.text:
正解：(A) None
• 考點：不定代名詞數量辨析。
• 解析：後方明確寫出 the three proposed rail routes（三條路線），故表達全否定須用三者以上的 None（沒有一條）。
• 誘答分析：(C) Either 與 (D) Both 僅限兩者；(B) Every 不可單獨接 of。
• 單字補充：per-ton freight rate 每噸運費率。

questions.q: Rising marine fuel prices have compelled major ocean alliances to ______ emergency surcharges on all transpacific bookings starting next month.

explain.text:
正解：(A) impose
• 考點：動詞搭配（impose surcharges）。
• 解析：燃料價格上漲迫使海運聯盟對跨太平洋訂艙「徵收/加收」緊急附加費，固定搭配為 impose surcharges。
• 誘答分析：(B) expose 暴露；(D) compose 組成；(C) dispose 處理（常接 of）。
• 單字補充：marine fuel 船用燃料油、ocean alliance 海運聯盟。

questions.q: The logistics software provides real-time visibility into inventory levels, ______ managers to rebalance stock before shortages arise.

explain.text:
正解：(C) enabling
• 考點：分詞構句（結果用法）。
• 解析：逗號前為完整句，逗號後用現在分詞 enabling 表「進而讓經理人能夠在缺貨前重新調配庫存」。
• 誘答分析：(A)、(D)、(B) 均不可無連接詞直接接於逗號後。
• 單字補充：real-time visibility 即時可視性、rebalance stock 重新平衡庫存。

questions.q: ______ carefully the packing list was prepared, a minor clerical error in the net weight column triggered a manual customs inspection.

explain.text:
正解：(D) However
• 考點：讓步複合副詞（However + 副詞/形容詞）。
• 解析：空格後緊接副詞 carefully，表達「無論裝箱單準備得多麼仔細，淨重欄的一個小筆誤仍引發人工查驗」，選 However（= No matter how）。
• 誘答分析：(C) Whatever、(B) Whichever 後接名詞；(A) Whenever 語意不合。
• 單字補充：clerical error 文書筆誤、net weight 淨重。

questions.q: Prior to signing the vessel charter agreement, the legal team scrutinized every clause ______ port storage fee liabilities and unexpected delay exceptions.

explain.text:
正解：(D) pertaining to
• 考點：分詞片語後位修飾與片語動詞（pertain to）。
• 解析：every clause（每項條款）主動「涉及/關於」延滯費責任，故用主動分詞 pertaining to。
• 誘答分析：(C) pertain to 無被動；(A) 缺少關代；(B) 不定詞表目的不合語意。
• 單字補充：vessel charter agreement 租船契約、unexpected delay 突發延誤。

questions.q: Thanks to dual-sourcing strategies adopted last year, the automaker remained largely ______ to the recent electronics shipping disruptions.

explain.text:
正解：(D) resilient
• 考點：形容詞字彙與介系詞搭配（resilient to）。
• 解析：受惠於去年採行的雙軌採購策略，該車廠對近期晶片海運中斷大致保持「具韌性的/不受衝擊的」（resilient to）。
• 誘答分析：(C) reluctant 不情願的；(A) redundant 多餘的；(B) reliant 依賴的（通常接 on 且語意相反）。
• 單字補充：dual-sourcing 雙重貨源採購、disruption 中斷。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).

explain.text:
正解：(C) Late
• 解析：前句規定必須在裝船前至少 24 小時傳送電子艙單，因此「逾期（Late）」提交的申報會在抵港時自動被標記扣留。
• 誘答分析：(A) Prompt 迅速的、(D) Prior 先前的、(B) Tentative 暫定的皆不合邏輯。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: The port authority has also announced plans to dredge the main shipping channel next spring.
Several ocean carriers have recently reduced their weekly sailings due to lower seasonal demand.
Importers must pay all outstanding terminal handling charges in cash before picking up freight.
This advance filing requirement is designed to strengthen border security and accelerate low-risk cargo release.

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：第一段末提到 24 小時預報規定，(D)「這項預報申報規定旨在強化邊境安全並加速低風險貨物放行」完美承接上文並說明立法目的。
• 誘答分析：(A) 疏浚航道、(B) 減少航班、(C) 現金支付碼頭費皆偏離主題。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).

explain.text:
正解：(C) transition
• 解析：舊版 EDI 系統將並行運作至 11 月 15 日，以利順利「過渡/轉換（transition）」。
• 誘答分析：(D) transaction 交易、(A) transmission 傳輸、(B) translation 翻譯均誤。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).

explain.text:
正解：(A) arise
• 解析：Should technical difficulties ______ 表「萬一發生技術困難」，不及物動詞「出現、發生（問題/困難）」固定用 arise。
• 誘答分析：(C) raise 及物動詞（舉起/提出）；(D) arouse 喚起；(B) rise 上升。
• 單字補充：cutover period 系統切換期、flag for hold 標記扣留。

Questions 135–138（歐洲鐵路走廊應變計畫電郵）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).

explain.text:
正解：(D) bulky
• 解析：While 帶出對比：高毛利醫療器材已取得優先艙位，而「體積龐大笨重的（bulky）」工業緊固件則面臨高達十天的延誤（後段也提到非緊急補貨改走海運）。
• 誘答分析：(A) urgent（與後段 non-urgent 衝突）、(B) fragile、D perishable 皆不適合工業緊固件。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: The Munich facility recently won an award for achieving zero workplace accidents in 2025.
To prevent assembly-line stoppages, we are activating our secondary multimodal routing protocol.
Our procurement budget for the upcoming fiscal year is currently under review by finance.
Consequently, EuroRail Freight has decided to suspend all passenger services along the corridor.

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：前段講鐵路延誤十天，下句馬上說明從週一起非緊急補貨改由鹿特丹經短程海運至漢堡再轉卡車，故 (B)「為避免產線停擺，我們正啟動備援複合運輸方案」承先啟後。
• 誘答分析：(D) 停駛客運、(A) 零工傷獎項、(C) 採購預算審核皆離題。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).

explain.text:
正解：(C) guarantees
• 解析：Although 子句用現在式 adds，主要子句描述該方案目前的常態效益，用現在簡單式 guarantees（確保可預測的交期）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 過去式、(A) 分詞缺主要動詞、(B) 現在完成式均不合。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).

explain.text:
正解：(D) Meanwhile
• 解析：前句請大家週五前更新 ERP 預測，本句要求「同時（Meanwhile）」直接與客戶經理協調通知最新抵達時段。
• 誘答分析：(C) Otherwise 否則；(A) Nevertheless 然而；(B) For instance 例如。
• 單字補充：multimodal 複合運輸的、replenishment 補貨、short-sea feeder 短程接駁船。

Questions 139–142（信用狀卸貨港瑕疵修改函）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (139).

explain.text:
正解：(C) inconsistency
• 解析：下段指出信用狀寫洛杉磯港，但船期只停長堤港，兩者存在「不一致/瑕疵（inconsistency）」。
• 誘答分析：(B) proficiency 熟練、(A) redundancy 冗餘、(D) sufficiency 充足皆誤。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).
options: Our company has been operating container vessels across the Pacific for over thirty years.
Resolving this discrepancy prior to shipment is essential to avoid payment delays.
Marine insurance premiums have remained stable despite recent weather events.
Both ports offer extensive rail connections to distribution hubs in the Midwest.

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：前句指出卸貨港不同，後句警告銀行會認定單證不符而拒付，(B)「在裝船前解決這項不符點對於避免付款延誤至關重要」正好銜接兩句。
• 誘答分析：(D) 鐵路聯通、(A) 營運三十年、(C) 保費穩定皆無關緊要。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (141).

explain.text:
正解：(A) issue
• 解析：instruct your issuing bank to ______ an amendment，不定詞 to 後接原形動詞 issue（簽發/開立修改書）。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(C)、(D) 詞形不符。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (142).

explain.text:
正解：(A) modification
• 解析：指代前句的 amendment（修改書），同義替換為 modification（修改）。
• 誘答分析：(D) negotiation 押匯/談判、(B) termination 終止、(C) compensation 賠償均誤。
• 單字補充：negotiating bank 押匯銀行、container stuffing 裝櫃。

Questions 143–146（冷藏貨櫃出車前檢查標準備忘錄）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (143).

explain.text:
正解：(A) worn
• 解析：與 uncalibrated（未校準的）並列修飾 door seals（門封條），須用過去分詞當形容詞 worn（磨損的）。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(D)、(C) 無法作為「磨損的」前位形容詞。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (144).
options: Singapore remains our fastest-growing market for organic produce in Southeast Asia.
Consequently, several new verification steps have been added to the mandatory loading checklist.
Refrigerated containers typically consume more electricity than standard dry vans.
Technicians will receive an annual bonus if zero equipment failures occur this year.

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：第一段說明莓果腐敗原因，第二段隨即列出兩項新增的技術人員檢查步驟，故 (B)「因此，強制裝載檢查表已新增數項驗證步驟」為最佳轉折句。
• 誘答分析：(A) 新加坡市場成長、(C) 冷藏貨櫃較耗電、(D) 年終獎金皆偏離主題。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (145).

explain.text:
正解：(D) Furthermore
• 解析：前句為第一項新增檢查（雲端溫度同步），本句為第二項新增檢查（門墊片漏光測試），用遞進副詞 Furthermore（此外）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 相反地、(B) 因此、(A) 反之皆不合邏輯。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (146).

explain.text:
正解：(B) mandatory
• 解析：主旨與語氣皆強調更嚴格的標準，故遵守規定是「強制性的（mandatory）」。
• 誘答分析：(A) optional 選填的、(C) temporary 暫時的、(D) arbitrary 任意的均誤。
• 單字補充：pre-trip inspection (PTI) 出車/裝櫃前檢查、gasket 墊片/密封圈。

questions.q: What will be suspended during the maintenance window on March 22?
options: Electronic entry lanes and train-loading facilities
Crane unloading operations using backup generators

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：原文 all automated container gates and rail-ramp operations will be completely suspended 同義改寫為 (A)「電子進出口車道與鐵路裝卸設施」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D) 泊位 4A、4B 的靠泊與備用發電機卸貨照常進行；(B) 入口網站仍可使用。

questions.q: What are local trucking carriers instructed to do if they have morning appointments on March 22?
options: Change their collection times online before Friday evening
Pay an extended port storage fee
Reschedule their appointments after 10:00 on March 22

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：原文 reschedule their pickups via the Terminal Portal no later than Friday, March 20, at 17:00 同義改寫為 (A)「在週五傍晚前線上更改取貨時段」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 免費期自動順延不罰款；(C)(D) 皆與公告截止時間不符。

Q149–Q150（Apex 報關合規顧問廣告）

questions.q: What service is offered free of charge to new annual retainer clients before June 30?
options: A free examination of prior duty charges

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：原文 complimentary 90-day historical tariff audit 同義改寫為 (B)「免費檢視過去的關稅支付紀錄」。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D) 為一般服務項目；(C) 90 天是「回溯稽核期間」而非諮詢天數。

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as an area handled by Apex?

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：廣告提及 HS 編碼稽核、退稅申請與保稅倉庫執照，未提及 (D)「脫歐後倉庫建設」。

Q151–Q153（即時通訊對話：休士頓港貨櫃查驗）

questions.q: Why is Liam concerned about the container from Ningbo?
options: A manufacturing site has minimal parts remaining.
The assembly line must pay overtime on Monday.
The VACIS X-ray exam will take longer than 48 hours.
Lone Star Trucking declined the Saturday delivery.

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：Liam 提到奧斯汀產線僅剩兩天安全庫存，同義改寫為 (A)「製造據點零件所剩無幾」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆引用 48 hours、Lone Star Trucking、overtime 扭曲時間與事實。

questions.q: At 09:20 A.M., what does Sarah mean when she writes, "They shouldn't need to empty the container"?
options: The truck driver does not need to wait at the Port of Houston.
Lone Star Trucking will charge the standard weekday rate.
The Austin factory will receive the motor housings before noon.
Inspectors will likely leave the goods inside.

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：They shouldn't need to empty the container 指 X 光掃描無異狀就不必拆櫃，同義改寫為 (D)「查驗人員可能不會把貨物卸出」。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(B) 皆引用 Port of Houston、before noon、weekday rate 誤解句意。

questions.q: What will Sarah do next?
options: Ask the customs broker to speed up the X-ray exam
Check pricing with a freight hauler for Saturday
Drive to the Port of Houston to observe the scan
Authorize Monday overtime for the Austin assembly line

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：Sarah 說要打給 Lone Star Trucking 確認週末費率，同義改寫為 (B)「向貨運業者查詢週六配送價格」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(D) 皆未在對話中安排。

Q154–Q156（Baltic Freight 燃油附加費調整通知）

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
options: To announce the cancellation of a Baltic Sea route
To announce a new ferry service starting on June 1
To inform a customer of an upcoming energy-fee change

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：主旨為通知 updated Fuel Adjustment Factor (FAF)，同義改寫為 (D)「通知客戶即將調整能源相關運費」。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(C) 引用 June 1、Agreement #BF-2026-04 錯置日期或目的。

questions.q: How can NordicTech qualify for the 14.5% FAF rate on a June sailing?
options: By booking exclusively out of Immingham
By shipping exclusively within the past 60 days
By having goods enter the port before June begins
By switching to the new hybrid-electric ferry on June 15

explain.text:
正解：(C)
• 解析：5 月 31 日 23:59 前進場（gated into）的貨物適用 14.5%，同義改寫為 (C)「在六月開始前讓貨物進入港口」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(A) 引用 MS Aurora、60 days、Immingham 設陷阱。

questions.q: What benefit of the MS Aurora is mentioned?
options: Earlier departures from Helsinki starting June 1
Reduced environmental impact for customer reporting
A 12 percent discount on base ocean freight

explain.text:
正解：(C)
• 解析：MS Aurora 可減少 15% 運輸排放，有助追蹤範疇三（Scope 3），同義改寫為 (C)「降低客戶永續報告中的環境衝擊」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(A) 引用 12 percent、June 1、17.0% 混搭數字。

Q157–Q159（文章：全球供應鏈「中國加一」策略）

questions.q: According to the survey, how have sourcing strategies changed since 2021?
options: More companies are concentrating production in Vietnam.
Apparel firms have stopped sourcing from India and Mexico.
A notably larger proportion of businesses now diversify across nations.
Electronics manufacturers have reduced their supplier count by 39 percent.

explain.text:
正解：(C)
• 解析：從 2021 年的 39% 升至 68% 採至少三國採購，同義改寫為 (C)「顯著較高比例的企業現在跨國分散採購」。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(D) 引用 Vietnam、India、39 percent 與調查相反。

questions.q: What challenge do emerging manufacturing hubs frequently encounter?
options: A shortage of Tier-1 suppliers in Singapore and Busan
Higher preferential tariff rates for locally assembled goods
Lack of access to regional trade pacts
Depth constraints that require smaller connecting vessels

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：shallower port drafts that prevent mega-vessels from docking directly, forcing reliance on feeder ships 同義改寫為 (D)「水深限制導致必須使用小型接駁船」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(B) 引用 trade pacts、Tier-1、preferential tariff 誤導。

questions.q: What do supply chain architects recommend for achieving genuine resilience?
options: Assembling all imported components in a single country
Eliminating all Tier-1 suppliers in East Asia
Relying exclusively on feeder ships through Busan

explain.text:
正解：(C)
• 解析：需盤點 Tier-2 and Tier-3 raw material vendors，同義改寫為 (C)「追蹤更上游的間接原物料供應商」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(A) 與專家建議相反。

Q160–Q162（TransGlobal Express 危險品受理規範）

questions.q: When must a Shipper's Declaration for Dangerous Goods be submitted?
options: In triplicate upon completion of the flight
Upon arrival at the acceptance counter
Within 24 months of renewing a training certificate
Two days or more before takeoff

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：at least 48 hours prior to scheduled flight departure 同義改寫為 (D)「起飛前兩天以上」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 引用 acceptance counter、24 months、in triplicate 錯置條件。

questions.q: What is required for an overpack containing multiple UN-certified packages?
options: A separate DGD certificate for each vertical side
Hazard labels on the top and bottom surfaces only
A metal outer crate instead of fiberboard
Prominent labeling meeting a minimum size standard

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：外包裝須標示至少 12 公釐高的 "OVERPACK" 字樣，同義改寫為 (D)「符合最低尺寸標準的明顯標示」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(A) 引用 fiberboard、two opposite vertical sides、DGD 扭曲規定。

questions.q: What happens if a shipper attempts to book a CAO item on a passenger flight?
options: It will be accepted only if accompanied by a 4G outer box.
It will be turned away with no reimbursement of reservation charges.
It will be transferred to a cargo flight for a small fee.
It will be held for 48 hours until a certified trainer arrives.

explain.text:
